description: Microsoft 365 & Azure admin: Graph, ARM, and the PowerShell cmdlets Graph does not expose.
name: io.github.HoussemMak/minerva-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Entra tenant id. Only needed for unattended app-only sign-in; omit it to sign in interactively with a device code.
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Application (client) id. Defaults to the public Microsoft Graph PowerShell client, so it is optional for trying the server out.
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Client secret for app-only authentication. Leave unset to sign in interactively instead.
environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: SharePoint root URL, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com. Required only by the SharePoint/PnP tool when PowerShell runs locally.
environmentVariables.name: MINERVA_SHAREPOINT_URL

packageArguments.description: Speak JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout. Required for local MCP clients; without it the server listens on HTTP instead.
packageArguments.name: --stdio

packageArguments.description: Refuse every write operation. Recommended when pointing the server at a production tenant.
packageArguments.name: --read-only

title: Minerva MCP — Microsoft 365 & Azure
